title: Hearty Savory Slovakian Shrimp Skewers
description: A low-calorie, velvety Slovakian dish featuring shrimp paste, perfect for a date night, with a resinous glaze that adds depth to the dish.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Grill the shrimp skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are pink and cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix together saeujeot and 1 tablespoon of water to make the glaze.
Brush the glaze onto the shrimp during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
